entry.title: Local UI5 development server fails with 404 Cannot POST when executing HTTP service requests
entry.content:
Environment: SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public Edition) 3-System Landscape, utilizing Developer Extensibility via Eclipse ADT.

Context: A custom backend HTTP handler is active, published, and successfully responds to direct browser requests (GET and POST) with status codes.

The Symptom: When running the custom SAP UI5 application locally via Business Application Studio (npm run start) after removing the local ui5.yaml proxy backend destination, relative fetch calls fail with a browser console error (404 Cannot POST or 405 Method Not Allowed). The local server attempts to route the request through its own host URL under a /test/ or local path context rather than proxying it securely to the public cloud tenant (my437226.s4hana.cloud.sap).

Expected Behavior: Local preview environments should seamlessly route service calls or provide native configuration guidelines for handling absolute routing and testing custom HTTP handlers without requiring local BAS proxy destinations that clash with standard public cloud deployment paradigms.

entry.title: Critical Outage: Dev Spaces failing to initialize core extensions
entry.content:
Hello Support Team,

We are experiencing a critical platform-level blocker within SAP Business Application Studio (BAS). Whenever we launch or initialize our Dev Spaces, the environment fails to activate any SAP-managed extension tools due to broken or missing internal dependencies.

Error Messages Encountered:
1. Cannot activate the 'vscode-mta-tools' extension because it depends on an unknown 'sapos.yeoman-ui' extension.
2. Cannot activate the extension because it depends on an unknown 'saposs.sap-ux-sap-systems-ext' extension.

Impact:
Because these core extensions fail to load, the graphical user interfaces, MTA build wizards, Fiori/UI5 tools, and destination connection managers are completely broken. Development activity is entirely halted.

Steps Taken to Troubleshoot:
- Completely stopped and restarted the Dev Space to force a fresh provisioning cycle.
- Created a brand new Dev Space (both Full-Stack Cloud Application and SAP Fiori configurations), but the new environment immediately spins up with the exact same missing dependency errors.
- Attempted to manually search for the dependent extensions in the internal BAS Extensions Marketplace, but they either result in registry search timeouts or fail to fetch.

This appears to be a regional infrastructure registry issue or a broken internal extension bundle deployment on the BTP backend.

Environment Details:
- Platform: SAP Business Application Studio (BAS)
- Subaccount Type: BTP Enterprise

Please investigate the internal registry health for this region as soon as possible.

Thank you.

entry.title: WZ My Team card is empty for non-managers
entry.content:
Reference https://help.sap.com/docs/successfactors-work-zone/configuring-and-using-sap-successfactors-work-zone/sap-successfactors-work-zone-cards

The My Team card documentation states: 

Shows the basic information of the user (manager)'s direct reports, such as email and time zone, and also supports manager self-service (MSS) cases.

If the user does’t have any direct report, the peers of the user are displayed on the list. This card was previously titled Org Chart.

However, this isn't the case when we tested in prod and lower environments. Non-managers always have it empty.
